$description: Hand-maintained manifest of every live-manipulable control on the shipped pages (epic #164 ticket #167) — the ONE hand-written input to agent-layer/gen-param-count.mjs, which emits system/param-count.json. A ticket that adds a control updates this file in the same PR (CLAUDE.md convention); an omission is a review-catchable gap, not a silent undercount. COUNTING RULES — Include: any element the reader operates (click / drag / type / key) that runs behaviour beyond following a hyperlink — inputs, radios, checkboxes, selects, action buttons (copy / download / share included), drop zones, editable fields, steppable players, focusable graph nodes, tab switchers; conditional controls (appear after a visitor action) count, marked with a note. Exclude: plain <a> navigation, <details>/<summary> content disclosures, glossary hover/focus bubbles (passive reading aids), inert specimens with no visible change, the injected chrome nav. Granularity: one entry = one distinct control per page — a radiogroup = 1, a per-item verb present on every board place = 1, a stepped player's button row = 1. The appearance dock is listed ONCE under the pseudo-page "chrome" (since #175 it mounts on all 10 pages; per-page listing would inflate). Scope: the 10 VR-gated shipped pages + "chrome" — instance.html (deep-link-only, private), agentic-ui-study.html and handoff.html (noindex, outside the VR 10) are out of scope. An in-scope page with zero qualifying controls simply has no entries (as of #176: contact and 404). The composed metric-tiles in proto/fieldwork's agentic slots are still non-interactive themselves; what #176 added is a control row BESIDE them, which commands their tone over the action bus — the row's picker, radiogroup and reset are the three counted controls, once each rather than once per slot.
